reads.title: T-3656, T-3657, T-3658: Add classroom tools, photo hunts and keyboard access
reads.body:
Students can save a cited record of a visit, teachers can print lessons, and visitors can play a daily photo challenge on the existing static site.

- **Photo and share:** save a stamped PNG from the current frame and copy a validated public moment link.
- **Field notebook:** keep notes, small photos, selected people and citations in bounded browser storage, with visible save errors and printable export.
- **Jaunt reflections:** answer three optional prompts from visited, cited evidence and review the sources.
- **Lesson guides:** print cited templates across ten year/group combinations and 192 school tellings, with suggested Illinois/C3 connections.
- **Daily photo hunt:** locate five credited photographs of four 1904 places, score ground distance, reveal documented dates and share the challenge date.
- **Targeted accessibility:** magnify/pan the Navigator with a stable drawing buffer; use keyboard-contained picture dialogs and reachable tabs. Focused controls retain native arrows/Space, and held world movement stops when focus enters a reader.

Capture uses the normal frame without another WebGL renderer or persistent drawing buffer. Images and storage are bounded; panels load on demand. Same-spot Jump stays lower priority. `docs/CLASSROOM-FEATURES.md` accounts for all twenty requested items.

The owner-authorized Full-detail ceiling moves from 3,605,000 to 3,630,000 triangles (+0.69%), supported by the recorded measurement. The source-command cap moves from 600 to 900 seconds; all eight partitions, their assertions and negative controls remain required.

Validation:
- Focused logic, native browser fixtures and published-town flows cover links/citations, bounded capture/storage, export/print, lessons, reflections, hunt score/share/reload, magnification and dialog behavior.
- Actual Navigator/capture/backend keyboard checks pass at both widths. XR tests execute the real capture registration, including independent XR/arrival/Window blocking, restoration and negative controls. Official isolation measurements pass.
- Published phone and desktop focus checks each pass 11 assertions with zero page/console/HTTP errors. They reproduce retained Navigator focus, prove native button activation, then explicitly establish world focus before the unchanged Space-inspection/no-flight assertions.
- Completed desktop stages 1–4 and 6–12 on `ddc786069` pass (320/0 and 111/0); stage 5 has an explicit 1835 asset/direct-API equality proof. Independent review confirms unchanged early-stage bodies, all 1,528 indexed 1835 assets, all 765 relevant liberty subsets and all three teacher catalogs; those passing results retain their original attribution.
- The first desktop 13–15 group failed (308/2): retained button focus in stage 14 and texture fetch errors during stage 15's reload. The updated harness establishes world focus and includes upstream T-3662's bounded picture drain. Error listeners and the zero-error assertion remain intact.

Phone stages 1–12 are complete on frozen `3472ec872`: 585 passed, zero failed. Stage 1 has an explicitly accepted recovered kernel-exit receipt; stages 2–12 exited normally (490/0). All final suite/page-error/vendor guards and the full 7,667-file mirror hash pass. The subsequent `af466d163` changelog fold affects stage 13, which is covered separately.

DEV then advanced to `8c605db05` with pre-fire research. Its 4D application and workflow trees are unchanged. The exact isolated merge `539f09beb` (tree `6b2c34dfa`) passes the normal publisher, published-source parity, site validation, pre-fire mirror parity and changed JavaScript syntax checks. The published 4D tree is 491.73 MiB under the unchanged 740 MiB limit; new media remain root-served without duplicate copies. These targeted results cover the actual DEV publication delta and retain the original attribution of earlier renderer/source results.

**Release checks remain pending on `af466d163`:** all eight source partitions plus aggregate, and fresh published desktop/mobile stages 13–15. Upload-release passes 32 checks. Moving-frames recorded one Balanced-flight maximum of 33.1 ms against the unchanged 32 ms limit; a single unchanged job retry is queued after verifying identical measured 1835 inputs, unchanged median and improved p95 against the preceding passing run. The original failure is preserved. No failed, capped, cancelled or incomplete group counts as passed.

[Evidence and recovery](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence) preserve exact inputs, logs, failures and scope limits. This covers items 2–5, 7 and a first slice of 10; physical-device testing and a complete assistive-technology audit remain. All three tickets are delivered here; #2199 is superseded. Target: dev.
